data_fields.name: ambush_zone_slots
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 slots; random start RAND(0,4), wrap, skip empty and current zone

data_fields.name: ambush_placement_cost
data_fields.donor_constant: far end cost minus DistanceScale*4/2 (half the leg)

data_fields.name: bounty_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: bntychnc row value; fires when RAND(1,100) <= value

best_idea: Roll the encounter once per leg of a trip, in travel order, stop at the first hit, and place the ambush at the midpoint of that leg from a five-slot zone list.
decision_why: Frankendom zones are data on one runtime, so a zone-to-zone trip with a per-leg interruption roll is reusable only if zones gain a route. The roll must run on the server and record the chosen zone and cost in the one ledger; the donor's global RAND and its mutable link state do not transfer.
acceptance: A server test: on a three-leg route with chances 0, 100, 0 the trip stops at the midpoint of leg 2 in a data-slot zone; with all chances 0 the trip reaches the target; a 100 chance with all five slots empty completes the trip with no ambush.
